The bundle was tested by comparing files it had chosen against the tree, which is a check that cannot see an absence.
proposals.cost_basis: estimate
proposals.gate: A packager states what it expects to include and fails when the count is zero, rather than shipping quietly
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: The failure is invisible to every check that compares what was packaged against what was packaged

proposals.objective: Write down that a refit must read the solved values, not the rounded ones a table shows
proposals.rationale: The wedge extrapolation was reported twice from the same rungs: minus 13.73 degrees from the values as the ladder table prints them at three decimals, and minus 15.753 from what the act solved. Two degrees apart, from rounding alone. The reason is mechanical and worth stating: at an observed order near zero the extrapolation amplifies the finest increment by more than forty, so the error in a printed value is amplified with it. Every refit this week that started from a document rather than a record inherits that.
proposals.cost_basis: estimate
proposals.gate: A refit states which source it read, and a check refuses a refit whose inputs came from a rendered table
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: The worse a ladder behaves the more its refit depends on precision nobody thinks about
proposals.outcome: Written down as VERIFICATION_CHARTER section 3.3a, with the mechanism rather than the caution, and given a checker. The rule: a refit reads the artifact the solver wrote -- a forces file, a coefficient file, a stored levels[] block -- never a document, because a rendered table has already thrown away the digits the refit needs, and how many it needed is a property of the ladder rather than of the reader. THE WORKED CASE, both readings on the record and neither withdrawn. The supersonic wedge ladder extrapolated from its rungs as the act's table PRINTS them, 47.588 / 46.123 / 44.693 at three decimals, gives a shock angle of -13.733 degrees; from what the act SOLVED, 47.58767882153372 / 46.12330850878531 / 44.692792746510406, it gives -15.753. Two point zero two degrees, entirely rounding. THE MECHANISM, which is why it is a rule: at an observed order of 0.034 the Richardson extrapolation amplifies the finest increment by 42.25, and any error in the stored rungs is multiplied by the same factor. The worse a ladder behaves the more its refit depends on precision nobody is thinking about, and badly behaved ladders are the ones that get refitted. The same rounding moved the cone 0.801 to 0.800, the diamond 6.233 to 6.296 and vortex shedding 2.436 to 2.430, none of which is near-zero order and none of which changed anything. The clause states plainly that nothing deciding anything moved on the wedge either: guards_failed, conclusive and reportable_band are identical on both readings and the angle is physically impossible on both. THE CHECKER, and its honest limit. self_audit.check_stored_rungs_carry_solved_precision computes, per stored study, the amplification its own extrapolation applies and how far half a unit in the last decimal its rungs are stored to reaches after that amplification, and reports any ladder where the reach exceeds a tenth of the study's own band. Measured on the corpus: all 6 extrapolating curriculum ladders store 10 to 18 decimals against amplifications of 0.02 (motorBike), 0.09 (naca4412), 0.85 (naca0012), 1.26 (ahmed_35), 2.32 (ahmed_25) and 3.48 (naca0015_sail), so the reach is under 1e-10 against bands of 5.3e-4 to 2.0e-2 -- nine orders of margin. IT WOULD NOT HAVE CAUGHT THE WEDGE, whose ladder lives in a campaign document and not in this corpus, and both the clause and the check's declared blind spot say so. It guards the corpus going forward. Zero compute against a zero estimate.

proposals.objective: Make the ladder band's extrapolation guard measure its tolerance against the three rungs it actually fitted, not against every rung the caller happened to pass
proposals.rationale: The guard rejects a fit whose Richardson value lands more than 15 percent of the measured range width outside that range. It fits the last three rungs but takes the range from all values handed in, so the same fit is conclusive or not conclusive depending on how many rungs the caller passes. The flat plate is the fixture the 15 percent was calibrated on and it sits on both sides of the line: handed the four rungs 816, 3264, 13056 and 52224 its extrapolate sits 8.48 percent above the top of the range and the ladder is certified with a band of 1.99e-5, which is 0.70 percent of the drag; handed only the three rungs the fit uses it sits 21.16 percent above and the same ladder is declined with the sentence that its extrapolate falls outside the range it measured. The tolerance comment records the 8.48 percent figure, so the calibration was done on a four rung call and the three rung call was never checked. Every other act calls this with exactly three rungs. Nothing here says which reading is correct, only that a certifier must not answer two ways to one fit.
citations: Roache, Verification and Validation in Computational Science and Engineering, on grid convergence index practice
Eca and Hoekstra 2014, procedure for the estimation of discretization uncertainty

The only curriculum record fitted from more than three rungs is b52, and it is declined either way, but not by the same margin - its Richardson value sits 247.43 percent of the fit triple's range above that range and 93.96 percent of all six handed rungs above theirs, a 2.6x difference in the excess a published record states. proposals.objective: Gate the NREL Phase VI blade forces that already exist on disk against the published low-speed-shaft torque in Hand et al. 2001, reported as a band over a stated averaging window rather than as a point, and rule on whether frozen-rotor MRF gets the mean right on a history it cannot settle
proposals.rationale: F8 is listed on the product list as MRF first, then transient. MRF first has already been run twice. The F8 phase6 MRF run directory holds a 230,135-cell UAE Phase VI Sequence S case at 7 m/s, checkMesh OK, taken to t=1500 on 2026-07-29 and restarted to t=3000 on 2026-07-30, and SIMPLE solution converged appears zero times in either log. The blade-force history widened rather than settled: Fx span 508 N over t=1500 to 2250 and 729 N over t=2250 to 3000, Fy swinging minus 775 to plus 1276 N against an original minus 336 to plus 280 N. More steady iterations demonstrably do not fix it and the campaign status already logs this as a genuine Group 3 convergence failure rather than glossing it. What has never been done is the comparison the case was built for. Hand, Simms, Fingersh, Jager, Cotrell, Schreck and Larwood 2001, NREL TP-500-29494, publishes low-speed-shaft torque and blade root bending moment against wind speed for the Sequence S test including the 7 m/s point this case is set at; the citation was found on 2026-07-29 and the tabulated data is not on disk. The measurement is a time average of an existing force history over a window declared before it is read, with its own spread, against that published torque. Prediction, written before the fetch: the mean will land within the oscillation half-width of the published torque, because the frozen-rotor limitation is a limitation on the history rather than on the mean loading, and the honest risk is the opposite, that a series which never settled has no meaningful mean at all. That risk is why the gate below fixes a maximum band width in advance.
citations: Hand, M.M., Simms, D.A., Fingersh, L.J., Jager, D.W., Cotrell, J.R., Schreck, S. and Larwood, S.M., Unsteady Aerodynamics Experiment Phase VI: Wind Tunnel Test Configurations and Available Data Campaigns, NREL TP-500-29494, 2001
The F8 phase6 MRF case on disk: its simpleFoam log and its blade-force post-processing output
The campaign status record, F8 correction of 2026-07-29 and the 2026-07-30 endTime extension
The not-passing register, Group 3 solver convergence

proposals.objective: Replace the R5 pre-registration's hand-chosen per-case hurt cap of +0.010 with a cap derived from the training split's own leave-one-out spread at a stated confidence level, record the derivation as a reusable threshold, and re-run the R5 GO/NO-GO against the derived cap without making a scoring call
proposals.rationale: The priority review closed on 2026-08-05 with element 4 verified as PRIOR-EXISTS in concept and NO-PRIOR-FOUND as a turbulence-closure instance. The concept's canonical statement is Thomas, Theocharous and Ghavamzadeh, High Confidence Policy Improvement, Proceedings of the 32nd ICML, PMLR 37, pages 2380 to 2388, 2015, abstract read verbatim from the PMLR record this session: the user may select any performance lower-bound and confidence level and the algorithm guarantees the probability of returning a policy below that bound is at most the stated confidence level. The same discipline appears in clinical trials as a non-inferiority margin pre-specified in the protocol so it cannot be chosen after the data. Our R5 gate has the pre-specification half and not the derivation half. The R5-alpha05 regime pre-registration, section 3, declares the cap before any leave-one-out delta exists, which is what protects against leakage, but it never says why 0.010, and the verdict turned on that number alone: variant B failed rule three at plus 0.0167 on alpha_05_4071_3036 while passing rules one and two. A cap that decides a NO-GO and cannot say where it came from is a constant in workflow code, which the innovation standard's stage 3 sends to the physics-rules registry as a number with a derivation. This is the literature charter's section 6 trigger 2 and the reading does not close without it. Prediction, written before the run: the derived cap will land above 0.010, because the training split's leave-one-out deltas already range to better than minus 0.035 and a spread-based bound at any conventional confidence level is wider than a round number chosen by eye, so the honest outcome may be that R5 passes a defensible cap where it failed an arbitrary one. That outcome must not be taken as authorising a scoring call by itself, because the cap is being redefined after its own verdict is known and that ordering is exactly what the R5 document's own section 6 refuses.
citations: The closure method-priority review of 2026-08-05, sections 2.4 and 7
The R5-alpha05 regime pre-registration, sections 3, 4 and 6

Thomas, Theocharous and Ghavamzadeh, High Confidence Policy Improvement, Proc. 32nd ICML, PMLR 37, 2380-2388, 2015, tier ABSTRACT READ, fetched from the PMLR volume 37 proceedings record on 2026-08-05
proposals.cost_basis: measured: the R5 training and leave-one-out run cost 62 s wall at a 2-core cap, about 2 core-min, recorded in the R5-alpha05 regime pre-registration. This item re-uses those already-computed leave-one-out deltas for the derivation and re-runs the selection arithmetic, so the compute is the same run at most once more plus seconds of arithmetic
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Either outcome pays. A derived cap that R5 still fails converts a hand-chosen NO-GO into a defensible one and strengthens the pre-registration section of both the submission draft and the LaTeX report, where the R5 no-go is currently the sole evidence that the discipline binds. A derived cap that R5 passes exposes that the entry of record was held at 0.0654 by an arbitrary constant, which is a finding about our own method rather than about the benchmark, and it produces the second-stage pre-registration that section 6 of the R5 document already names as the successor candidate. Either way the lab gains one threshold with a stated derivation, reusable by any future gate, and a citation of the established form of the rule where it currently has none

proposals.objective: Test whether B3's adjoint failure (PETSc DIVERGED_NANORINF at iteration 0) is caused by a non-finite value already present in the converged primal state, by scanning every primal field cell-by-cell for non-finite entries before the adjoint is launched
proposals.rationale: B3's discrete adjoint dies with DIVERGED_NANORINF at GMRES iteration 0, reproduced identically across four configurations: two primal convergence levels, two objective types, and two ILU fill levels. Mesh quality was checked and cleared. Failing at iteration zero, before any GMRES progress, means the non-finite value is present in the operator or the right-hand side at the moment they are assembled, not generated by the solve. The adjoint linearizes about the converged primal state, so a single cell holding an inf or NaN in any primal field would produce exactly this signature. A converged residual norm does not exclude it: the norm is a sum over cells, and a non-finite entry in a field the residual does not weight can sit there unnoticed. That the failure is invariant to convergence level, objective and preconditioner is the strongest evidence for it - all three are downstream of the state, and none of them would change a poisoned input.
citations: Certonomous DAFoam Case Status, Ladder B3 stage 3 blocker
proposals.cost_basis: estimate, field scan is IO-bound, no solve required to test the hypothesis
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: A cheap test of the only hypothesis that explains all four reproductions at once. If it holds, B3 unblocks and the lab gains a preflight check that belongs in front of every adjoint we ever run. If it fails, we have eliminated the state and the search moves to the operator assembly, which is where it should go next anyway.
proposals.dismiss_reason: Hypothesis tested and KILLED, at zero solver compute. A cell-by-cell scan of every field the adjoint reads - 886,833 numeric tokens across 13 files, including U and UData which the earlier partial check never covered - found zero non-finite values, and the mesh log confirms no degenerate cell volumes. The primal state is finite everywhere, so it is not the poison. Two further candidates were eliminated by structural reasoning rather than compute: the design-variable Jacobian enters only after the adjoint vector is solved, so it cannot sit inside an operator that diverges at iteration zero, and the objective derivative is only the right-hand side, whose norm printed finite for both objectives tested. Search now narrowed to a derivative singularity inside the transpose Jacobian or its preconditioner, most plausibly the low-Reynolds near-wall closure terms at the near-zero turbulence wall boundary condition. Successor test in flight.

proposals.objective: Add a Sobol sensitivity mission type that apportions output variance across the input spreads before any uncertainty reduction campaign is priced
proposals.rationale: The lab propagates input spreads through Monte Carlo but never says which input owns the variance, so reduction work is untargeted. The mission ends with a ranking of inputs by variance share and a recommendation of where the next samples or the next measurement effort should go.

proposals.objective: Move the generated case's mesh seed off the symmetry planes it currently sits exactly on
proposals.rationale: external_aero._snappy() sets locationInMesh by stepping the geometry centre downstream along the streamwise axis and leaving the other two components at the centre. On a body whose generated domain is exactly symmetric that puts the seed exactly on both remaining symmetry planes, and whether refinementParameters::findCells finds a cell there turns on the floating-point parity of the background division counts. It is not hypothetical: meshing the NACA 0012 at (42 77 26) on 2026-08-02 died with 'Point (6.5 0 0) is not inside the mesh or on a face or edge' against a bounding box of (-3 -9 -3) to (7 9 3) that plainly contains it, while (33 60 20), (54 98 33) and (64 116 39) on the same case survived. The NACA 4412 is immune only by accident: its STL is slightly asymmetric so its domain runs z from -2.96598 to 3.03582 and its seed lands at z = 0.0349165, off-plane. So a symmetric body is one division count away from a hard mesh failure, and the failure looks like a geometry problem rather than a seed placement one. The fix is to offset the seed by a fraction of a background cell in the two non-streamwise directions. The offset is not free and its cost is measured: nudging the NACA 0012's seed to (6.5 0.1 0.1) and changing nothing else moved the r1 mesh from 140,580 cells to 140,545 and the r3 mesh from 358,486 to 358,430, 0.025 and 0.016 percent, so any body whose stored cell count came from the unnudged seed will not reproduce it to the cell after the fix.
proposals.cost_basis: measured; the two re-meshes that quantified the offset cost about 2 core-minutes at 1 core, and the fix needs one re-mesh per affected body to record the new count
proposals.gate: A generated case seeds its mesh off every symmetry plane, and each affected stored cell count is re-read rather than assumed unchanged
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: A mesh failure mode that reads as a geometry defect, removed, with the cost of removing it measured rather than assumed zero

proposals.objective: State the duct secondary-flow zero as a structural limit of the linear eddy-viscosity class, defended from the integrity basis the lab has read, with a pre-registered falsifier run before the claim is published
proposals.rationale: The gate measurement stands: uncorrected k-omega SST produces exactly zero secondary flow on both scored ducts, machine precision near 1e-15 of bulk, where the reference field carries 2.22 and 2.07 percent of bulk velocity, and the supervisor analysis bounded that missing flow at no more than 24 percent of the duct error, so this is a deficiency statement rather than a score lever. The lab has since read the primary source: a linear closure keeps only the first tensor of the ten-tensor basis, and the transverse block that drives secondary flow of the second kind sits in the second and third tensors, measured on duct training cases at 71 and 91 percent of their magnitude. The constructive half is already on the docket as the tensor-basis carrier; this is the analysis half, turning a table row plus a read primary source into a stateable, defended result with its falsification attached. The falsifier names its instrument: the toolchain's shipped quadratic eddy-viscosity closure, run once on the smallest training duct's existing mesh, graded by the same cross-plane velocity probe the gate measurement used, whose resolution already expressed a zero at 1e-15 and a signal at 2 percent, so the criterion is expressible by the instrument. Prediction, written before the run: the quadratic closure produces nonzero transverse mean flow at the percent-of-bulk scale, because its added term carries exactly the normal-stress anisotropy the linear term cannot. If it also reads zero on the same mesh, the structural claim is refuted as stated and the zero becomes a setup question, which would redirect the duct effort before any carrier is built. Axis scores: gate three over ten on knowledge per core-min, zero wall row, zero challenge columns because the analysis produces no scored predictions. No new family enters; the duct family and its meshes are already in the lab, and the one solve is a discriminating control on it.
proposals.cost_basis: estimate anchored to measured runs: the gate measurement itself cost zero new core-min by reusing converged baselines, the duct meshes run 2,209 to 31,819 cells, and the sparse regression rung measured 137 core-min for two far larger frozen cases plus nine propagations, so one quadratic-closure solve on the smallest training duct is priced at ten and the analysis at zero
proposals.gate: The written result states what the linear class drops, cites the measured zero and the read basis at their provenance tiers, and does not publish without the falsifier's outcome on the page: nonzero transverse mean flow from the quadratic closure on the same mesh confirms the structural reading, a second zero refutes it, and either outcome is recorded with the run's artifacts retained under the campaign
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Two distinguishable outcomes, each changing a decision: the falsifier produces transverse flow and the lab owns a defended structural result that fixes the ordering of the reproduction ladder and names the floor no scalar correction crosses, or it reads zero and the deficiency stops being attributable to the closure class, which stops the tensor-basis carrier from being built on a wrong premise

proposals.objective: Measure whether the NASA hump reattachment responds to the SST shear-stress limiter constant a1, turning the omega-budget implication from the executed QCR arm into a mechanism or sending the question upstream
proposals.rationale: The challenge-conditions run confirmed the bubble bias at +13.92 percent on a verified pipeline and the QCR2000 arm returned a null at the pre-registered materiality bar, ruling out the constitutive route on the hump leg and implicating the separated-shear-layer stress magnitude. The limiter is the single named constant that caps exactly that stress: in the limited regime the eddy viscosity is proportional to a1, and the limiter is expected active in a separated shear layer. Two variations, a1 at 0.28 and 0.34, bracket the stock 0.31 by roughly ten percent, the spread the literature itself carries for Bradshaw's structure parameter that a1 encodes. If reattachment moves materially with a1, the mis-scaled-stress hypothesis gains a mechanism with a measured sensitivity slope; if it does not, the limiter is exonerated and the budget question moves upstream to the omega production and destruction balance, exactly as the review's outcome block frames it. Prediction, registered before any solve in the pre-registration file: the limiter is active in the bubble, a1 at 0.34 shortens the bubble past the materiality bar toward the experiment without repairing it to the gate

proposals.objective: Rewrite the upstream report's framing and its why-unnoticed section from the DAFoam method papers now read in full, and run the papers' own published gradient check once per decomposition so the report can say the toolchain's own protocol fails when its never-varied axis is varied
proposals.rationale: The three DAFoam method papers were fetched and read in full on 2026-08-04 (reading notes W2_DAFOAM_AIAAJ2020_VERIFICATION_READING, W2_DAFOAM_CAF2018_VERIFICATION_READING, W2_KENWAY_PAS2019_EFFECTIVE_ADJOINT_READING; synthesis DAFOAM_PAPERS_VERIFICATION_PROTOCOLS). The reading dissolves the contradiction our upstream report currently claims: the AIAA Journal abstract's under-0.1 percent and 1536 cores were two disjoint experiments, both on the v1 explicit FD-Jacobian architecture, while the matrix-free reverse-AD operator family that v5's calcJacTVecProduct descends from has exactly one published accuracy measurement and it is serial by design, with the survey's own conclusions stating the absence of parallel data in so many words. No paper varies a decomposition anywhere, no paper verifies any adjoint on a refinement-interface mesh with a stated graph partitioning, and no paper states a halo-exchange tape caveat, so the report stays a bug report but no longer needs to argue against a peer-reviewed number, which strengthens it. proposals.objective: Anchor the NACA 4412 credential reference on a lift coefficient independent of the solve being graded, replacing the current self-referential anchor
proposals.rationale: The reference is built as section drag plus induced drag evaluated at the solve's own lift, so a solve that over-predicts lift is graded against a wider band. Measured tonight: a 25.0 percent lift over-prediction inflates the induced term by 56.2 percent and lifts the whole band with it. Grading each rung against its own anchor puts the two best-resolved rungs out of band at 94.2 and 94.5 percent layer coverage while the worst-resolved rung at 4.4 percent coverage passes. The grade can be bought by getting lift wrong in the generous direction, so no verdict from this method is currently trustworthy

The premise -- 'a refined near-wall setup can close the gap or explain it' -- is refuted twice on this body's own measurements. (1) The graded rung ALREADY IS the refined near-wall setup: add_layers true, 12 prism layers, target y+ 30, 94.5 percent of target layer thickness. (2) ACTIVE_RESEARCH.md section C3, measured 2026-07-28: across a 17.7-fold change in boundary-layer coverage from 4.36 to 77.0 percent at fixed refinement, DRAG MOVED 0.037 PERCENT. Near-wall resolution is measured not to be the lever on this body's drag. The item's own numbers are also stale: it quotes Cd 0.0183 against reference 0.0136, 35 percent off. The reference was replaced on 2026-08-01 (commit d45f3090) because it moved with the lift of the solve it graded; it is now 0.015696 with a fixed +/-9.56 percent band, and the graded rung reads +16.35 percent, not 35. WHAT WAS RUN INSTEAD, and why it is the experiment this item needed. The graded rung rebuilt at four background blockMesh division triples, everything else byte-identical, 4 ranks scotch, 161,312-166,719 cells per rank. Every replicate study this lab had run -- Ahmed 25, cube, NACA 0015 sail, NACA 0012 -- was addLayers FALSE, and the 4412 is the only wall credential graded from a LAYERED mesh, so none of that scatter transferred. Driver sdk/scripts/naca4412_layered_replicates.py, cases /home/ubuntu/certonomous-runs/w3-naca4412-layered-replicates. CONTROL HOLDS: A at the stored (33 60 20) reproduces 645,251 cells exactly, Cd to 1.6e-05 relative (0.018262714 vs stored 0.018262421), Cl to 3.3e-05, and max non-orthogonality to every printed digit. RESULT. Cd = 0.018262714 (33 60 20), 0.020787415 (34 59 21), 0.019911782 (32 61 21), 0.020803581 (34 60 21); against the 0.015696 reference that is +16.35, +32.44, +26.86, +32.54 percent. ALL FOUR OUT OF BAND ON THE SAME SIDE, so the NOT VALIDATED verdict IS reproducible across mesh construction -- unlike the NACA 0012, where one of four was out and three were in. That is a real check this credential passes. THE VALUE IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE. Range 2.540867e-03 = 12.74 percent of the mean, which is 165x the graded solve's own iterative 2-sigma and 1.69x the ENTIRE half-width of the band it is graded against. It is 28x the 0.45 percent the four finest ladder rungs agree to across a 3.2-fold cell-count change, and 344x the layer-coverage effect. Lift is worse at 15.57 percent. And the published mesh is the MINIMUM of its own family, i.e. the most favourable of the four -- the mirror of the 0012, where it was the maximum. A FIFTH MESH COULD NOT BE BUILT AT ALL: (35 58 20) is rejected by snappyHexMesh, 'Point (6.50165 0 0.0349165) is not inside the mesh or on a face or edge', because locationInMesh sits at the span centre and lands exactly on a block-face plane whenever the span division count is even. The stored production triple has an even span count and got away with it. AND A SECOND, UNASKED FINDING: this record's grid_study note names the finer rung's 74.96 max non-orthogonality as 'degraded, not improved, at the largest cell count' and 'the leading suspect for the non-monotonicity'. Replicate C reaches 74.962443 at 653,090 cells against the finer rung's 74.962218 at 1,849,113 -- agreeing to 3.0e-06 relative -- because 74.96 is the mesh-quality dictionary's own relaxed ceiling (external_aero.py:403, relaxed { maxNonOrtho 75; }). The other three sit at 64.958-64.990, just under the STRICT maxNonOrtho 65. Every mesh in this family except the medium rung is pinned to one of its own two dictionary limits, so a 70-degree gate applied to this field is a coin whose faces are 65 and 75. Whether the rest of the wall is pinned the same way is a check, not a claim. The credential record is annotated accordingly. COST: 29.608 core-min CPU basis against the filed ESTIMATE of 20 (1.48x over) and against 28 re-derived from this body's own measured graded run (1.06x over) -- the cost-basis rule holding again. Meshing is itself construction-sensitive: snappyHexMesh took 76.4, 73.1, 96.5 and 361.8 s on the four triples, a 4.7x spread on a job priced as meshing-bound. WHAT REMAINS, and why this stays approved rather than closing: the gap is now measured and attributed to mesh construction rather than to near-wall resolution, but it is not CLOSED -- the credential is still NOT VALIDATED and the honest next step is a replicate family at a resolution where the scatter is small enough to state a verdict, exactly as W3_NACA0012_VERDICT_NOT_REPRODUCIBLE.md proposed for the 0012. proposals.objective: Replace the fixed per rung iteration caps in the flat-plate ladder with a cap derived from the rung's cell count, and re check the bump and airfoil ladders for the same defect
proposals.rationale: The flat-plate ladder's caps were 3000, 4000, 5000, 9000 and 15000 for rungs of 816, 3264, 13056, 52224 and 208896 cells. The three coarsest exited early on their residual test at 482, 966 and 2846 iterations, so their caps never bound anything. The two finest ran to their caps. Measured on this hardware on 2026-07-31, the finest rung at its 15000 cap still had drag falling by 1.04e-5 per thousand iterations and a peak to peak spread of 4.44e-7 over its last fifty, which is more than four times the module's own flatness gate of 1e-7, so the module would have refused to extract the rung it had just spent an hour computing. The iteration count needed scales with cell count and not with rung index: fine to finer took 3.99 times as many iterations to reach one part in ten thousand of its own final drag, against a cell count ratio of 4. A cap chosen by hand per rung is a guess that gets worse the finer the grid, which is exactly where the ladder needs it most.

(1) The flat plate's cap is derived from cell count: tmr_verification.iteration_backstop(cells) returns 2.0 * (30720/208896) * cells, rounded up to a whole thousand and floored at 3000, and SETTLE_ITERATIONS_PER_CELL is measured on the one rung that was run until it settled -- the 208,896-cell flat plate reaching SETTLE_TOL at iteration 30720, 0.147 iterations per cell. (2) and (3) The bump and the airfoil were re-checked and carry the same fix: line 1888 sizes the bump's controlDict from iteration_backstop(level.cells) and line 2686 the airfoil's, and BUMP_ITERATIONS_AS_GUESSED and NACA_ITERATIONS_AS_GUESSED both carry the comment 'Nothing sizes a run from them.' The flat plate is at line 841 and the alpha sweep at 3033. SCRUTINY ON THE ONE NUMBER THAT LOOKS LOOSENED. The item quotes a flatness gate of 1e-7 and the module now carries SETTLE_TOL = 3e-7. That is not a loosening: the 1e-7 applied to a fixed 50-iteration window, which the module's own comment shows is a plateau detector rather than a settle detector -- a tail-50 rule at 1e-7 stops the finest rung at iteration 19463 with Cd 0.268 percent above where it finishes, 1.8 times the band the ladder goes on to report. The 3e-7 applies to a window that grows to a quarter of the run, capped at 2000 iterations, so it is a far stricter test. It is read off five solved rungs and its consequence is stated: applied live it would have stopped the four settled rungs with 0.0006 to 0.0069 percent of Cd left to move, at most 5 percent of the discretization band, and the record admits that the 52,224-cell rung inside the certified finest triple never reaches it in the 9000 iterations its cap allowed, exiting at 5.522e-07, 1.84 times the tolerance. The fixed cap concealed that; the new criterion reports it. INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE FOR THE ITEM'S PREMISE, measured tonight on a different module. The B-52's rungs run at a fixed 300-iteration cap that never moved with cell count, and their final-window 2-sigma at that cap reads 1.07e-05 at 255,358 cells, 2.25e-06 at 330,950 and 3.584e-05 at 441,057 -- the finest is the least settled, by 16 times against the middle rung. Three points are not a trend and none is claimed; what is claimed is that the same defect the TMR module fixed is still live in run_uq_studies, where ITERATIONS is a module constant of 300 for every body and every rung. That is worth its own item and this one does not cover it. Zero compute spent against est_core_min 20.0.

proposals.objective: Run the eighth B-52 refinement rung with the alternative pre-registered alongside the monotonicity prediction, and measure whether the recipe refines the near-body cells uniformly between rungs or merely rescales the background block, which is the mechanism that would explain seven non-monotone rungs
proposals.rationale: This is agp-1dec50b65c2f made launchable, with the one addition the record says it needs. The ladder in the B-52 uncertainty study record runs 0.05512, 0.04477, 0.04905, 0.04720, 0.04957, 0.05228, 0.04822 at 40,656 to 441,057 cells, monotone false, conclusive false, band recorded as the largest spread times 1.25 at 0.00507. Rung 7 was pre-registered with a prediction that Cd would rise and that prediction scored FALSE, which is on the record in the rung 7 results write-up. An eighth rung that predicts monotonicity again is making the same bet a second time and would learn nothing new from a second miss. The alternative that has never been measured is in the ladder's own notes: every rung from production onward scales the background blockMesh divisions (41x36x60, then 46x40x67, 51x45x75, 55x49x82) while holding the near-body shell level at 2 and the maximum cell level at 4. If the near-body refinement levels are fixed, the cells at the surface where the drag is integrated may barely move between rungs while the total cell count nearly doubles, and a ladder whose refinement does not reach the integration surface is not a uniform refinement and cannot produce an observed order however many rungs it gets. That is a measurement, not an opinion: it is the surface-cell size and the surface-cell count per rung, and it can be read off meshes that already exist before the eighth is generated.

DO THE ZERO-COMPUTE HALF FIRST and write it down before generating any mesh: for each of the six existing rung meshes, report the aircraft-patch surface face count and the minimum and mean surface cell size against that rung's total cell count. proposals.objective: Run the Woodward and Colella double Mach reflection, a Mach 10 shock meeting a 30 degree ramp, on the proven density based compressible line at two grid resolutions, and gate the self similar primary triple point trajectory angle against the published reference computations at a tolerance declared before any solve
proposals.rationale: The compressible line is the lab's most proven stack: the supersonic exact theory suite passed all three gates with surface pressure within 0.07 percent of oblique shock theory, and the hypersonic blunt body family reached both gates against the Billig correlation within 2.33 percent, all on the same shipped density based solver run natively. Double Mach reflection is the canonical stress test of a shock capturing scheme on a genuinely two dimensional unsteady shock structure: two triple points, a slip line, and a near wall jet whose resolution separates dissipative schemes from sharp ones. The lab has never run it and the repository has zero hits for it. Prediction, written before any solve: the primary triple point trajectory angle lands within the declared tolerance at both rungs with the fine rung closer, and the near wall jet is visibly damped at the coarse rung, because the central upwind flux is more dissipative than the reference's PPM. The known instrument risk is the locator: the supersonic suite's own record says shock angle detection from smeared fields was its weak spot at 2 to 4 percent, so the locator increment is stated and checked against the tolerance before the first solve, per the case selection charter's detector first rule. Axis A: 3.0 gain points over 20 core minutes. Axis B: none at first filing; a clean pass is a candidate row against a published benchmark computation with no experimental anchor. Axis C: zero, no scored column moves

Either answer routes the batch's k-family coverage: shared means one initialization fix re-opens four dead cells across two families; specific means the exclusions are case physics and stand. proposals.objective: Establish whether the F5c backward-facing step steady solve can converge at all, on a detector fine enough to read the answer, before any unsteady solve is proposed for it
proposals.rationale: RE-POSED 2026-08-10 in the running agent's words, chief-adopted: YOU CANNOT ASK WHETHER A FLOW IS UNSTEADY UNTIL THE STEADY SOLVE IS SHOWN ABLE TO CONVERGE. The item's original premise was a -10.5% steady miss with wander. Stage A (F5C_STAGE_A_RESULTS.md, 27a94361) withdrew the -10.5% to unmeasured on pre-registered outcome O3, and found what no bar had asked for: no F5c run has ever converged, at any iteration count up to 20,000 - the 8,000-iteration leg sits 66x off its p gate and 847x off Uy, and the original record's 'deep numerical convergence' read the LINEAR solver's final residuals rather than SIMPLE's initial ones. The isolating arm (F5C_LEVER_ISOLATION_RESULTS.md, prereg 9eaefc7f) then proved non-convergence a second way that needs no residual at all: relaxation factors cannot move a converged SIMPLE fixed point, and two solves differing ONLY in relaxation disagree by 4.224 H, a factor of 2.6 in the gate quantity. So half the original premise is withdrawn and half is stronger than ever, and the ordering is wrong rather than the question: an unsteady probe run against a steady baseline that was never converged cannot discriminate a formulation mismatch from an unfinished solve. The wander is real and unmeasured - chief policy forbids any wander verdict from the coarse detector whose wall faces are 0.55-0.81 H apart against a 0.20 H bar, and no xr-* level has ever been run.
proposals.gate: One detector-resolved run on xr-coarse (28,300 cells, faces <=0.05 H through the closure region), sampling the x_r history throughout, asking one question: DOES x_r SETTLE AT ALL? Outcome one: it settles, F5c has a reattachment number for the first time, and the unsteady question is answered NO at a fraction of an unsteady solve's cost. Outcome two: it does not settle at a cost the lab will bear, which is the evidence-based case for the unsteady branch and a far stronger one than the premise this item was filed on. Outcome three: it settles but elsewhere, and the case reopens on the number rather than the formulation. The relaxation check is carried as a mandatory second limb, because it is immune to the residual-reading error that produced this entire thread: two runs differing only in relaxation must agree at convergence.
proposals.cost_basis: UNPRICEABLE, and recorded as unpriceable rather than estimated. The prior 25 core-min figure is withdrawn. Stage B's 35-39 core-min for xr-coarse at 8,000 iterations is a FLOOR, not an estimate: 8,000 iterations is MEASURED insufficient on the coarse mesh, which is 3.1x cheaper, and 20,000 is measured insufficient there too. A floor is not an estimate, and calling one an estimate is the forecast-basis error the calibration scorecard names as its central finding. What CAN be priced from measurement: a 20,000-iteration xr-coarse run at ~88-97 core-min (basis: 0.084-0.093 s/iteration measured twice on 9,050 cells serial, scaled by 3.127x cells under a stated and falsifiable at-most-linear assumption) buys the x_r history and a convergence-rate curve from which the real cost becomes estimable for the first time.

Either the case gains its first reattachment number and the unsteady hypothesis retires cheaply, or non-convergence is established on a detector that can see it, which converts the unsteady branch from a guess into the indicated next step.

proposals.objective: Run the dissipation study the NACA 0012 status record names as its honest next step, on one rung, and decide whether the TMR airfoil ladder is reachable by any scheme this solver has
proposals.rationale: The status record's own findings say a time-accurate solve with averaged coefficients, or a dissipation study, is the honest next step. The first half is priced out: the C4 closure measured 11,700 to 30,300 core-minutes for ONE rung to reach 30 convective units, and about 117,000 to 303,000 for the hundreds of convective units the scoping proposal itself asked for. The second half has never been filed, and nothing anywhere in the docket asks it. It is also nearly free, and most of it is already measured. Second-order momentum advection gives a sustained force oscillation that never decays, antisymmetric on a symmetric case with Cl swings of 0.3 at alpha 0. First-order momentum is perfectly steady and unusable, Cd 0.0229 and overdiffused. TVD limitedLinear sits between them: the cycle drops to about 3e-4 around Cd 0.0090 and never flattens over 15,000 iterations. The feedback is localised to the wake and trailing-edge convection. What has never been done is to walk that axis systematically on one rung and ask whether ANY admissible scheme reaches the settle criterion, because if none does, two approved items totalling 753 core-minutes are asking for something this solver configuration cannot produce, and that is worth knowing for about twenty. The mesh is not the escape route: measured 2026-08-02 directly from the published node array, the 2.645e7 maximum cell edge ratio is NASA's own grid geometry rather than converter damage, and the conversion is faithful to the point, its 29,152 points being 225 by 65 by 2 nodes less exactly the 49 coincident wake-cut pairs per plane.

proposals.objective: Test whether A1's sign-flipped leading-edge shape derivative (idx6) is caused by discrete non-differentiability at the wall-function switching threshold, by measuring whether leading-edge cells cross that threshold under the finite-difference perturbation
proposals.rationale: A1's CD/shape check fails on one component: idx6, the leading-edge combo mode, is sign-flipped and accounts for 82.7 percent of the squared-error norm. It is step-independent, survives a 3.65x mesh refinement, and the frozen-wall-distance mechanism was measured to contribute exactly zero. Root cause is unidentified and this is the deepest open question in the ladder. A mechanism nobody has tested: the Spalart-Allmaras wall-function branch is a discrete switch on the near-wall cell state. If leading-edge cells cross that switch between the plus and minus finite-difference perturbations, the function being differenced is not continuous there, so the finite difference is estimating the slope across a step rather than a derivative, and the adjoint, which linearizes one branch only, is right while the check is wrong. That would explain step-independence, which a truncation-error story cannot, and it would explain why only the leading edge misbehaves while mid-chord and aft components agree to 1.5-6.4 percent. The measurement is cheap: instrument the near-wall cell state at each perturbed configuration and count threshold crossings. If none cross, the hypothesis dies and we have eliminated it for good.
citations: Certonomous internal root-cause study of the leading-edge shape derivative, sections on localisation and on the frozen-wall-distance mechanism
Certonomous DAFoam case survey, cross-rung finding on the airfoil shape-derivative disagreement
Spalart & Allmaras (1992), one-equation turbulence model for aerodynamic flows

proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Either the root cause of the lab's longest-standing gradient defect, or the elimination of the most plausible remaining mechanism. Both outcomes end a line of inquiry rather than extending it. If confirmed, it also tells every future user of this stack that a wall-function case cannot be gradient-verified by finite difference at the wall without checking for branch crossings first, which is a transferable result, not a local fix.

Wall-face values were then measured for five fresh independent runs - baseline, the suspect mode plus and minus, and a healthy control mode plus and minus. Zero of 126 wall faces are clipped at any configuration; the global minimum sits about 400 times above the clip floor and moves by under 0.2 percent, no more erratically for the broken mode than for the healthy control. The probe was validated by reproducing this case's own established finite-difference values to four significant figures, so the null result is a measurement rather than a broken instrument. Successor hypothesis in flight: the suspect mode is the only combination mode among otherwise single-station modes, and its opposite-direction motion at a high-curvature leading edge may degrade cell quality asymmetrically between the two perturbation directions, so the check differences across two differently-degraded meshes while the adjoint linearises about the undegraded one.

proposals.objective: Adopt a multifidelity Monte Carlo propagation scheme that fuses the reduced-order ensemble with a few anchoring solver evaluations instead of racing them
proposals.rationale: The race act already produces the exact data multifidelity fusion needs: the same designs evaluated through the reduced-order lane and the solver lane. Multifidelity Monte Carlo is an unbiased control-variate estimator; the measured correlation between the paired lanes and the measured cost ratio decide the optimal sample allocation analytically, and also decide honestly whether fusion pays at all. Today the pairing is discarded once the race ends. The scheme keeps the solver in the loop for the accuracy guarantee, uses the reduced-order ensemble for volume, and reports one fused envelope with the correlation and allocation on the record.

proposals.objective: Establish how often a solver's convergence reporting can mask a run that did not converge, by classifying every run this lab holds with an automated checker and separately auditing what a sample of published papers on our own validation cases actually state about convergence
proposals.rationale: In a single night this lab found SIX published numbers of its own resting on runs that never met their convergence criterion, including one inside the correction that fixed the first two. They hid in four distinct ways: a normalised residual collapsing to a tiny fixed value while raw statistics showed a blow up; a solver exiting zero having printed a success message over a residual that underflowed to denormal range; a run reaching its iteration cap with no convergence statement while a plausible residual was quoted anyway; and a final residual quoted where the gate tests the initial one. A seventh form was found in the case configuration rather than the log, where the convergence gate named fields the turbulence model does not transport and therefore could never fire. Every instance was found by somebody looking at something else. Two observations make this worth studying rather than merely fixing. First, an automated sweep of 92 run logs classified 55 as not converged, and although the large majority were already known and disclosed, nobody had ever counted. Second, the literature review found that the best known reproduction of one of our validation cases never states a convergence tolerance anywhere in the paper, and that its closest agreement with experiment is attributed by its own authors to a coarse mesh numerical viscosity accident rather than to a modelling result. If a defect this easy to hide occurs six times in one lab's own work in one night, the reasonable prior is that it is widespread, and nobody appears to have measured how widespread.
citations: Certonomous convergence audit and automated checker, validated against 13 known answer cases, 2026-07-30
Certonomous literature reproduction review, on convergence tolerances absent from published reproductions
ASME V and V 20 on solution verification

Our own rate is the uncomfortable part of the evidence and makes the study credible rather than accusatory, since we found it in ourselves first. It also converts a piece of internal tooling into a contribution, because the checker is the instrument the study needs and it already exists.

proposals.objective: Make a generated refinement ladder vary one knob, and make the guard check comparability rather than distinctness
proposals.rationale: geometry_study.refinement_rungs() is asked for three rungs at refinement 3, which is every act on the generated-case path. base-1 and base-2 both floor to level 2, so only one level step actually happens, and the coarse rung is manufactured with a second knob instead: block_scale 0.7 on the background mesh. The resulting ladder refines the background on its first step and the near-body levels on its second, and no knob moves twice. A background change scales h everywhere with one ratio; a level change refines only at the surface, the feature edges and inside nearBody and leaves the farfield untouched, so it has no single r and a Richardson expansion has nothing to expand in. Confirmed from primary dictionaries on four bodies: ahmed_25, ahmed_35, naca0012_wing, naca4412_wing. It shows in the fits -- the NACA 4412's level step has the smaller cell ratio, 1.2658 against 1.3554, and moves Cd 5.5 times further, and the fitted p is 10.467. The docstring states the intent plainly: the second knob exists 'so the cell budgets stay distinct', and the guard that was added checks distinctness. Distinctness is not comparability. Two fixes are wanted: produce rungs that vary the background alone at a stated constant ratio, and add a comparability guard that refuses a ladder whose rungs do not share one refinement recipe, the way b52.json's recipe_audit does by hand.

But the block predates the sub-LU unblock that later cleared the incompressible family, and that unblock was never carried to M6; separately, the liaison's research found the official transonic tutorial setting a transonic preconditioner option our M6 records never set. That is a gap, not a verdict, and one arm on the cheapest mesh closes it either way: convergence reopens the A3 ladder and gives the breakdown story its epilogue, and a second breakdown confirms the conditioning wall beyond the incompressible family with both known unblocks tested
proposals.gate: One adjoint solve on the vcoarse M6 mesh with the sub-preconditioner set to LU and the transonic preconditioner option set as the official transonic tutorial sets it, nothing else changed from the archived arm. Outcome one: the adjoint converges, the A3 ladder reopens, and the breakdown record gains an epilogue naming the settings that were missing. Outcome two: the adjoint breaks down again, and the conditioning wall is confirmed beyond the incompressible family, with both known unblocks on the record as tested and insufficient
proposals.cost_basis: estimate, the review's figure: the vcoarse M6 adjoint has run before and failed by breakdown rather than by walltime, and the two settings change conditioning rather than problem size, so the archived arm's spend is the anchor
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Either the A3 ladder reopened by a setting that already existed, which converts a blocked family into a running one for the cost of a single arm, or the conditioning wall confirmed as real beyond the incompressible family, which is the epilogue the breakdown record currently lacks

proposals.objective: Measure how much of the CBFS velocity error an eddy-viscosity-form correction can absorb on its own, by propagating the frozen extraction with the residual anisotropy term switched off and again with it on, and set the fraction beside the 70.5 to 92.1 percent Dow measured
proposals.rationale: Dow's structural-uncertainty method rests on one premise: that most of the RANS to truth velocity discrepancy can be represented as eddy-viscosity discrepancy. He measured that premise on eight random separated channel geometries and got 70.5 to 92.1 percent of the discrepancy norm, read from his Table 4.2 and checked here by arithmetic after two of its cells were found damaged by the scan. This lab has never measured its own equivalent on any case, and it now needs to, because the beta inversion on CBFS plateaued at about 0.09 percent of its data term against a 30 percent bar with a gradient verified against finite differences to better than 0.2 percent on four cells. A verified gradient and a flat objective point at what the optimizer is allowed to change rather than at the machinery, and the parameterization is the suspect: Dow infers the eddy viscosity itself, which enters the momentum equation directly, while beta multiplies a source term of the omega equation whose solution then has to produce the eddy viscosity through a transport operator, and wherever the stress limiter binds the eddy viscosity has no algebraic dependence on omega at all. This proposal tests the premise without touching the adjoint, because the frozen extraction already built for the sparse-regression rung produces exactly the decomposition needed: it converged on CBFS in 295 iterations at 6.2 s of CPU and outputs both the deficit term and the residual anisotropy that no eddy viscosity of any magnitude can represent. Propagating with the anisotropy term scaled to zero isolates the eddy-viscosity-form part; propagating with it on is the full correction and is already run. The verified sign conventions from the same work are reused unchanged, including the measured ratios that convicted each flipped sign. Both arms restart from the shipped baseline, as the source method specifies. Both cases involved are benchmark training cases and no scored test case is opened.

proposals.cost_basis: measured: the earlier regression rung recorded a propagation on this case settling at 15,000 iterations in about 15 to 16 core-min under load, and its nine propagations across two cases summed to 118.6 core-min. This item is two such propagations differing in one scale factor, so the estimate is two of the upper figure with a small allowance. proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Three distinguishable outcomes and each one changes the next decision. If the eddy-viscosity-form part alone absorbs a fraction inside the band the source measured on separated flows, the premise under the whole uncertainty program holds on our case, and the beta parameterization is what stands between the lab and it, which makes a direct eddy-viscosity inversion worth pricing. If it absorbs far less while the full correction absorbs much more, the premise fails on this case, the residual anisotropy is the dominant error, and no richer scalar inversion would have rescued the plateau, which retires a line of work cheaply. If neither arm absorbs much, the finding is about the reference data or the propagation rather than about either method, and the band program stops before anything is sampled

proposals.objective: Establish whether the shape derivative disagreement against finite difference is a step size artefact by sweeping the difference step across several decades
proposals.rationale: On the official unmodified airfoil tutorial the geometric constraints verify to 4.4e-14 and the flow parameter derivatives to 0.232 percent, so the harness is sound, yet the drag shape derivative shows 11.43 percent on the difference vector norm while the two gradient magnitudes agree to 0.451 percent. Same length, different direction is the signature of per component difference noise rather than a scale error, and step size is the first thing that would move it. Every future adjoint claim on a shape variable rests on knowing whether that 11 percent is the check or the gradient

proposals.objective: Run the model-form matrix on the ERCOFTAC periodic hills, the standing batch's four closure families on the medium rung of our own verified mesh, to learn whether any closure enters the literature reattachment band and whether the inter-model band contains it
proposals.rationale: The hills closed with a physics FAIL, reattachment 72 percent long against the literature band, and the failure was verified onto the model rather than onto us: our own mesh agrees with the shipped grid to 0.043 percent with 0.097 percent grid sensitivity. What the verdict taught is that SST overpredicts separated-region length on the hills the same way it does on the hump, a two-leg pattern. The standing model-form batch already runs four closure families on other cases; extending its family set to the hills asks the two questions the verdict left open, whether any closure enters the band and whether the inter-model band contains the reference, and feeds the epistemic-uncertainty showcase directly.
proposals.gate: Four solves, one per closure family, on the medium rung of the verified in-house hills mesh, each read against the published reattachment band under outcomes declared before launch. Outcome one: at least one closure lands inside the literature band, which locates the failure in closure choice rather than in the class. Outcome two: none does but the inter-model band contains the reference, which is the epistemic-uncertainty result. Outcome three: even the inter-model band excludes the reference, which is a class-level finding. No scoring call is made; the matrix reports whichever outcome the runs deliver
proposals.cost_basis: estimate, the review's own figure: four closures at the medium rung of a ladder whose rungs this campaign has already run and logged, so the per-solve price is anchored to the family's recorded spend rather than to a guess
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Either a closure that works on the hills, which redirects the two-leg separated-flow finding from the class to the closure, or a measured inter-model band whose relation to the reference is exactly what the epistemic-uncertainty showcase needs from its training-class flow

proposals.objective: Give the curriculum ladders the cell-count-derived iteration cap the TMR ladders already have
proposals.rationale: tmr_verification fixed this on 2026-07-31 in ec7ca9d5: iteration_backstop(cells) sizes a run from a measured 0.147 iterations per cell, the flat plate, bump and airfoil all use it, and the guessed dicts are kept only as history with the comment 'Nothing sizes a run from them.' run_uq_studies did not get the same treatment. ITERATIONS = 300 is a module constant there and every rung of every body is asked for exactly 300, from the B-52's 40,656-cell coarse rung to its 441,057-cell seventh, a factor of eleven in cells at one budget. It is not academic. The B-52's rungs never print 'SIMPLE solution converged' at all, so settledness on that body is only ever measured after the fact from the force history, and the final-window 2-sigma at that fixed cap reads 1.07e-05 at 255,358 cells, 2.25e-06 at 330,950 and 3.584e-05 at 441,057 -- the finest rung is the least settled by 16 times against the middle one. Three points are not a trend and none is claimed; the point is that nothing in the runner is watching, and the one rung that decided the TMR ladder was exactly a rung whose fixed cap stopped it 1.05 percent above where it settled. Note the wings are the counter-example and belong in the fix's reasoning: they carry residualControl at 1e-4, they stop on it, and their iteration counts are FLAT across a 3.7x change in cells -- 153, 148, 142, 156. So the answer is not simply a bigger number; it is a settle criterion that drives the run, with the cap as a backstop, which is precisely what iteration_backstop already is. || MEASURED THE SAME NIGHT, on a third body, and it changes what the fix has to be. A cube production-mesh run at endTime 3000 instead of 300, nothing else changed, mesh reproducing 299,493 cells exactly (/home/ubuntu/certonomous-runs/w3-cube-settle, pre-registered at demo-output/website/campaign/W3_CUBE_SETTLE_PREREGISTRATION.md commit ee30a7c3, interim results at W3_CUBE_SETTLE_RESULTS.md commit 03cab7b9): between iterations 300 and 400 the trailing peak-to-peak collapses 16-fold from 2.1011e-02 to 1.2776e-03 and the trailing mean drops 6.345e-03, settling at about 1.0978 and holding there to roughly 1e-03 through iteration 1131. So the cube's fixed 300-iteration cap stops it mid-transient, and the value the credentials wall publishes is read about 6.3e-03 high -- 81 percent of the plus or minus 0.0078 envelope printed beside it. THE PART THAT CHANGES THE FIX: the cube fails the fixed cap in the OPPOSITE direction to the flat plate. On the flat plate a tail-50 spread read as a plateau while the value was still 1.05 percent from home -- the cap made the run look calmer than it was. On the cube the window 2-sigma at the cap is 1.4686e-02 while the distance still to travel is 6.3e-03, so the cap makes the run look WILDER than it is, by 2.3 times. A single tolerance will not serve both, and a single per-cell budget certainly will not: iteration_backstop is sized at 0.147 iterations per cell from the flat plate, which at the cube's 299,493 cells would budget 88,000 iterations for a body that is done at about 500. The fix is a settle criterion driving each run on its own history with the backstop as a backstop -- which is what this item already asks for, and this is the evidence for why it must not be simplified into a bigger constant. || COMPLETED 06:42: the cube ran the full 3000 and NEVER converged on residualControl, yet its trailing mean is stable to 2e-05 from iteration 900 through 3000 while its trailing peak-to-peak stops falling at 1.1472e-03 and holds. Settled Cd 1.097819606 against 1.104100119 at the 300 cap, a distance of 6.2805e-03. So the residual criterion and the force criterion disagree on this body and disagree decisively: a settle criterion reading the force stops it at about 900, and the residual criterion never stops it. That is the strongest argument this item has -- a bigger cap does not help a run whose residuals will not converge, and iteration_backstop()'s 0.147 iterations per cell would budget this body 88,000 iterations. A mechanism is named and not claimed: a spread that plateaus at constant amplitude is a limit cycle rather than a fixed point, which a bluff body with a separated wake would be expected to produce; confirming it needs a frequency analysis of the force history that was not run. If it holds, this body's published Cd is a mean over an oscillation and the runner has no concept for that at all. Record: demo-output/website/campaign/W3_CUBE_SETTLE_RESULTS.md, commit e16452d0. Cost 68.5 core-minutes at 4 ranks. proposals.objective: Identify the cause of the airfoil case's remaining shape-derivative error on its two interior leading-edge stations, which is now known not to be the mesh-warp defect and which worsens under mesh refinement
proposals.rationale: The airfoil's headline defect was resolved tonight and traced to the mesh warp's own linearisation for opposing-direction combination modes. The two interior stations adjacent to the leading edge were then tested against that same mechanism and CLEARED: under the real objective seed they return 11.92 and 11.58 percent, matching their independently measured values to within 0.08 points, with no sign flip. So the warp adds nothing to them and this case carries a SECOND, distinct defect. Its signature is diagnostic and unusual: the error is step-independent, and it grows under mesh refinement. Ordinary discretisation error shrinks under refinement, so whatever this is, it is not that -- and the direction of the trend is itself a strong clue, since very few mechanisms get worse with resolution. Candidates worth separating are a geometric quantity that becomes more singular as cells shrink near a high-curvature edge, and a term whose linearisation error scales with a mesh metric rather than with cell size. The link-by-link isolation approach is what finally resolved the first defect after six wrong mechanisms and should be applied here rather than guessing again.

Certonomous airfoil case survey, mesh-refinement behaviour of the interior station errors

proposals.objective: Establish whether the cylinder ladder's Strouhal gates are sensitive to near-wall spacing at every rung or only at the highest one, by running a matched-spacing twin at the ladder's best-gated low-Reynolds rung and comparing the shift against the one already measured at the top
proposals.rationale: A matched pair at the ladder's top rung, differing only in first-cell height by 55 percent, moved drag by 7.1 percent, base suction by 6.9 percent and fluctuation amplitude by 3.3 percent , all small against the 50 to 100 percent deviations those quantities carry versus the three-dimensional reference. Strouhal moved 35.1 percent, from 0.2409 to 0.1564, and that is large enough to flip which side of the reference band the run lands on, over-predicting in one member and under-predicting in the other. An independent windowed transform confirmed two genuinely distinct frequency bands rather than a period-detector artifact. So at that rung the Strouhal gate is not a solid measurement. Nothing is known about the lower rungs, which have no twins, and the ladder reports a Strouhal trend ACROSS rungs, and that is a trend whose sensitivity is therefore unquantified at every point but one. The best-supported reading is that the sensitivity belongs to a chaotic-dynamics regime in which a finite window no longer contains one robust dominant frequency, which is consistent with published evidence that two-dimensional confined cylinder wakes are fully chaotic well below this Reynolds number. That reading predicts the low rung will be ROBUST. Falsifiable either way: if the low rung's Strouhal moves comparably under the same spacing change, the sensitivity is not regime-related and every Strouhal gate on this ladder is soft; if it holds within a few percent, the sensitivity has an onset and the lower gates stand.

Certonomous literature reproduction review, on two-dimensional wake chaos below this Reynolds number

A gate that moves 35 percent under a mesh parameter nobody varied is not a gate, and we currently cannot say whether that applies to one rung or to every rung. It also tests the chaotic-regime explanation on a prediction it makes rather than on the observation that motivated it.

proposals.outcome: The low rung is robust and it is not close, so the chaotic regime reading survives a prediction it made rather than the observation that motivated it. A matched twin at Reynolds 1000, 22,400 cells in both members, first cell 0.00447 against 0.0069416 for an achieved ratio of 1.5529306 against the Reynolds 3900 pair 1.5529226, moved Strouhal by 0.120 percent, from 0.2343330 to 0.2346138. The same perturbation moved it 35.1 percent at Reynolds 3900, a factor of 293. Every other gated quantity moved one to two orders less: drag 0.653 percent against 11.0, lift peak to peak 0.412 against 6.3, base suction 0.576 against 6.9, recirculation length 0.196 percent. Strouhal is the LEAST sensitive quantity at this rung where it was by far the most sensitive at the top. The lower Strouhal gates stand and the onset is bracketed between Reynolds 1000 and 3900, not located, because Reynolds 2000 has no twin. proposals.objective: Expose a per-cell beta on the SST omega DESTRUCTION term, so the roadmap's original Stage 1 target and the Wu, Zhang and Zhang reproduction become buildable
proposals.rationale: Roadmap 4A Stage 1 was written as beta on the SST omega-destruction term. DAFoam does not expose that. Read directly from the installed source, DAkOmegaSST.C line 743: betaFIOmega_ multiplies the omega equation's PRODUCTION term, and the destruction term's beta is the F1-blended model constant with no field hook. The two are not equivalent, because the other omega terms do not scale with beta, so scaling production by beta and scaling destruction by 1/beta give different equations. Ruling R6 restated Stage 1 to the production-term inversion, which is what can be built, and refused to let it inherit the destruction-term goal. This is that goal, filed on its own with the work it actually needs. It matters beyond wording: Wu, Zhang and Zhang invert on the destruction term, so until this lands the lab has no like-for-like reproduction of its own top-pick paper and no score it produces may be set beside theirs.
proposals.cost_basis: Estimate, and the solver time is the small and well-anchored half. Measured on this host in the S1 field-inversion record: one gradient on the 5,000-cell tutorial case, primal plus adjoint at 4 ranks, costs about 25 s wall or 1.7 core-min, and peak memory left 18.99 GB free. Verifying a patched destruction-term hook is the same cycle on the same case: a directional finite-difference check against the adjoint, of the same shape as the 34 fresh-process FD evaluations S1 already ran, which bounds the compute at roughly 30 core-min including reruns. WHAT IS NOT PRICED HERE, and it is the part that decides the item: patching DAkOmegaSST to carry a second READ_IF_PRESENT volScalarField on the destruction term, registering it through DAInputField, and rebuilding the model inside the DAFoam container. That is a build the lab has never done for DAFoam, it costs no solver time, and it may not be doable inside the shipped image at all. Price the build question before the solve, the same way the duct-Reynolds item was repriced.
proposals.gate: A per-cell beta on the omega destruction term, driven through DAFoam's discrete adjoint on the 5,000-cell tutorial case, with a finite-difference agreement of the same order S1 achieved for the production hook, 2.67 percent on the real objective direction. A documented statement that the patch cannot be built or registered inside the shipped image closes the item just as well, and closes it cheaply.
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Turns the roadmap's original Stage 1 from a goal nothing in the stack can express into a buildable one, and is the precondition for any like-for-like reproduction of the top-pick closure paper
proposals.progress_note: 2026-08-04, W2 reading: full patch spec now exists at demo-output/website/campaign/W2_WU_ZHANG_DESTRUCTION_FIML_READING.md section 5, read from the installed v5.0.0 source in dafoam/opt-packages:latest. The change is two lines plus a mirror field: the destruction term '- fvm::Sp(phase_() * rho() * beta * omega_(), omega_)' at DAkOmegaSST.C:745 (calcResiduals) AND :870 (getFvMatrixFields, the preconditioner -- both or the PC is inconsistent) gains a multiplier [(betaFIOmegaDestr-1)*fd+1] with fd = 1-tanh((8*rd)^3) computed in-model (paper Eq. 5-6; the 8 is Spalart 2006's SA value, NOT OpenFOAM's SST-DDES Cd1=20). Registration is name-only: a whole-repo sweep shows betaFIOmega has no registration outside the model class; DAInputField.C:107 resolves fieldName by mesh-DB lookup, so cloning the READ_IF_PRESENT/default-1.0 constructor at DAkOmegaSST.C:137-146 under the new name is the whole wiring. AD needs nothing per-term: the ADF/ADR build variants differentiate the source by operator overloading. The 'may not be buildable' risk is half-retired: the image ships the full source tree with Make dirs, and dafoam-subpclu:v1 on this box is precedent for a patched rebuild; build wall-time still unmeasured. SCOPE CORRECTION from the same reading: the rank-2 entry model is SST-QCRC -- it also carries an untrained QCR2000 constitutive term (c_r=0.3) in the momentum equation, so this patch alone reproduces the paper's inversion capability, not the entry's deployed model; duct-score parity additionally needs w3-qcr-constitutive-term-for-rank2-parity, filed by the reading. proposals.objective: Isolate the second failure regime -- rotations just above the guard threshold -- to a line the way the first one was
proposals.rationale: The same parameterization fails twice. Below the sqrt(eps) guard the derivative is silently zero, which is now localized and demonstrated. Just above it the branch runs but computes argb = -(angleb/sqrt(1-arg^2)) with arg approaching one, where 1-arg^2 is formed by catastrophic cancellation. ONERA M6 measures that regime at 1.0 to 1.3 percent -- three orders above the 1e-6 percent the same mesh reaches with rotations off, and far too small to notice without looking. This is the regime a real optimisation sits in after the first design iteration, so it is the one that matters for a converged result, and it is the one still described as a measurement rather than a mechanism.
proposals.cost_basis: measured; the ONERA M6 geometry run took under a minute on 4 cores this session
proposals.gate: Error reported as a function of rotation angle across the threshold, with the cancellation either confirmed as the cause or ruled out
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: Says whether the workaround and any fix need to cover one regime or two
proposals.decision_note: Approved under Katie's standing authorization, 2026-07-31: 'You also have my OK for all ur proposals dont wait for me to confirm.' Blanket, not per-item, so the hardness floor and the cost basis still gate what actually runs.
proposals.outcome: DONE 2026-08-02, zero solver compute against a 30 core-min measured estimate. PREMISE CORRECTED FIRST: the item says the second regime is 'still described as a measurement rather than a mechanism', which was true at filing but was already half answered on 2026-08-01 -- ROOTCAUSE section 6.4 measured the error-vs-angle curve and named vectorUtils_b.f90:133. What was never done, and what this item actually needed, is TESTING that attribution. It is wrong. Repairing each candidate line in isolation (rotation_branch/independent_check/regime2_mechanism.py + .log, run 2026-08-02T08:27:46Z): at theta=5e-08 the shipped reverse reads 1.161e-02 relative error; repairing ONLY line 133's sqrt(1-arg^2) gives 9.663e-03, repairing ONLY the angle gives 6.436e-03, and repairing BOTH gives 3.083e-09. At theta=2e-08: 5.286e-02 -> 4.483e-02 -> 2.801e-02 -> 4.844e-09. Over 200 random (v1, mib, tilt-axis) draws per angle the denominator fix buys 1.0x-1.6x and the pair buys 2.1e+03x to 3.7e+07x. GATE ANSWERED, and the answer is 'confirmed as A cause, ruled out as THE cause': the cancellation is real and severe -- 1-arg^2 is wrong by 11.0% at theta=2e-08 and 2.3% at 5e-08, measured directly against sin(theta)^2 with no derivative involved -- but it is one of two comparable terms. The carrier is angle = acos(arg) in the PRIMAL at vectorUtils.f90:69-70, relative error ~eps/theta^2, which the reverse inherits through sin(angle), cos(angle) and angleb. Neither term is sufficient alone and they do not add, so each single-line repair reads as a null result. That is how this stayed asserted for a day. ITEM'S OWN QUESTION ('does the fix need to cover one regime or two') ANSWERED: two, and they need DIFFERENT fixes. The shipped degenerate-branch patch is primal-bit-identical by design; a regime-2 fix cannot be -- Mi moves 1 ulp at theta=1 and 2.0e-08 at theta=2e-08, where the whole rotation contribution is itself only O(2e-08). The substitute sin(angle) = axisMag/(magv1*magv2) is free (axisMag is already computed in the primal) and accurate to 0-5.0e-15 relative. SIDE RESULT: section 1.7's singularity-free form measures 6.3e-13 to 2.2e-12 across every angle tested INCLUDING inside the guard ball, where every acos-based variant reads exactly 1.0. It is the only single change covering both regimes, which strengthens w5-idwarp-singularity-free-rotation-patch. STATED AGAINST OURSELVES: this is a numerical study of a faithful transcription, not a run of IDWarp. It says which lines carry the error in the algorithm as written; it does not measure what tilt angles a real deformed mesh visits, so ONERA M6's 1.02%-1.26% mapping to theta ~ 5e-08 off this curve remains an inference. Written up as ROOTCAUSE_getRotationMatrix3d.md section 7, with section 6.4's line attribution superseded in place rather than deleted. Commit 4e01ef0e.

proposals.objective: Pin the mechanism of the decomposition-dependent adjoint gradient on the case that proved it, by running the three discriminating experiments from the liaison memo in their stated cost order
proposals.rationale: A4's verdict closed on 2026-08-04: the published 10.04 percent adjoint error is an artifact of the default scotch decomposition, confirmed by an adversarial supervisor sweep whose own independent re-run reproduced the np 2 cell to every printed digit. At fixed rank count four the analytic gradient reads 8.95 percent from its own finite difference under scotch and 0.00054 percent under simple 4x1x1, the converged baseline drag is invariant to five significant figures, and tightening the linear tolerance four orders changes nothing, so it is a converged wrong answer. The liaison's research pass found no upstream report of a decomposition-dependent gradient anywhere, recorded as negative searches, while the toolchain's own journal paper reports average adjoint derivative error under 0.1 percent at up to 1536 cores. A pinned mechanism therefore contradicts a published upstream claim, which is the literature charter's trigger three, and the liaison recorded the proposal as mandatory once A4 closed. The open reach item asks which other cases the defect touches; this one pins the mechanism on A4 itself with the memo's three discriminators, cheapest first: the bitwise primal compare across decompositions, the cross residual of the scotch adjoint vector evaluated under the serial operator, the volume-mesh coordinate gradient compared across decompositions, the preconditioner matrix dumped under both decompositions and diffed in global cell ordering, and a coloring-off run last. Prediction, written before any run: the cross residual will be large, because the tolerance-ball mechanism it discriminates was already disfavoured when four orders of tightening moved nothing. Axis scores: gate three over forty-five on knowledge per core-min, zero wall row, zero challenge columns. A large cross residual with preconditioner entries differing at partition corners convicts the parallel assembly and yields a novel defect report for upstream, where no such report exists and the published claim reads the opposite. A small cross residual makes the loose acceptance gate the cause and changes the linear tolerance policy on every multi-rank gradient the lab publishes.
