proposals.outcome: PARTIAL, and left approved rather than done because the gate says EVERY published shape-gradient claim and two are not regradeable from what this box holds. Five cases re-run stock-then-patched, same case, same rank count, same FD step, back to back, with two controls throughout: every Fd Magnitude is bit-identical between the stock and patched halves (the patch touches derivative code only, so a moved FD would invalidate the comparison), and every stock re-run reproduces its published table to every printed digit. MEASURED: A1 NACA0012 np=2, CD/shape 11.43 -> 0.03745 percent (absolute error 7.415918e-03 -> 2.430027e-05, a factor of 305) and CL/shape 1.671 -> 0.01494 percent, patchV and the geometric constraints unmoved, baseline primal identical at 9.646409714038222e-09. A5 U-bend pressure-loss np=4, the published configuration, 46.6377 -> 2.2372 percent, baseline TP1 2869.524210823638 identical in all three of published/stock/patched -- this is the claim that MOVES UP, and the caveats are on the record beside it: 2.24 percent is 60x A1's patched residual and is unexplained, and no shipped stack produces it. naca0015 sail coarse np=3, CD/shape 4.5230 -> 0.0246 percent and CL/shape 0.5303 -> 0.0125, so 99.5 percent of that published PASS was the defect, and the sentence calling it better-behaved than A1 is struck: corrected, the sail is 0.0246 and A1 is 0.0374. A4 Ahmed np=4 is the counterexample and it does NOT close: 10.04 -> 8.953 percent, so only about 11 percent of A4's disagreement is the rotation defect and the other 89 has no identified cause; the grade stays CONDITIONAL and the file's unreconciled PASS wording is superseded. A2 MACH wing: NOT REGRADED, and the reason is a provenance failure worth more than the number would have been. Its patched check_totals died at perturbation 132 of 211 with a DAFoam mesh-quality error after 238 core-minutes; four solves of nominally the same case give CD 0.02772949, 0.03142018, 0.02964133, 0.03162406 -- a 14 percent spread with CL climbing 0.4776/0.4967/0.4999/0.5216 as copies chain -- and a pre-registered gate to rebuild the mesh and reproduce the published CD failed at 0.02964133. So benchmarks.html's six VERIFIED rows and its 28.3 percent drag reduction cannot currently be re-verified by anyone; filed as BLOCKERS.md B-7 with the unblock stated as a gate. What WAS measured on A2's own geometry: a stock/patched pair restricted to the 7 twist DVs returns BIT-IDENTICAL analytic magnitudes 2.020405e-03 and 2.266683e-02, so the correction is a no-op there and A2's two twist rows hold; its two shape rows and the 28.3 percent do not get to borrow that, because local FFD shape modes are exactly what A1 shows the defect reaches. Cost: 620 core-minutes against est_core_min 300, of which 333 bought no derivative table (238 on the failed A2 run, 95 on an A5 stock-objective run stopped deliberately to free cores); the six runs that produced numbers cost 141 between them. Estimator lesson: check_totals buffers its table until every perturbation finishes, so wide-DV sweeps on this stack should be split into of/wrt subsets by default -- the twist subset cost 93 core-minutes where the full sweep is 210. CLOSED 2026-08-02 (well W4), and two of the statements above are RETRACTED. B-7 was not a provenance failure: every A2 run in this session invoked runScript.py, the AEROSTRUCTURAL variant (TacsBuilder + MeldBuilder, ScenarioAeroStructural, aoa0=4.65), while A2's published numbers come from runScript_AeroOnly.py (ScenarioAerodynamic, aoa0=4.0) -- the variant A2's own record discloses. The published log carries zero MELD/TacsDVComp mentions and DV groups patchV/shape/twist; this session's carries six and four struct_pre. The four-row CD table was four different physical configurations, so there is no 14 percent spread, and 0/ and 0.orig/ in the preserved case are byte-identical on all six fields so nothing was carried forward. Run with the right script from a pristine clone, stock toolchain: the primal returns CD 0.02772949388 / CL 0.4775877833 to all ten printed digits in 40 s, and check_totals returns 18 of 18 rows identical to the published log to every printed digit, CD/shape's 1.713791e-02 included. REGRADED under the corrected derivative, 236.7 core-min, with every FD magnitude identical between the halves on all 18 rows, patchV bit-identical and every geometric constraint unchanged at machine precision: CD/shape 1.71 -> 0.0506 percent, CL/shape 1.17 -> 0.0219, CL/twist 1.12 -> 0.0097 (factors of 34, 53 and 115, so A2's published rows were 97-99 percent rotation defect like A1's 1.671), while CD/twist DEGRADES 0.389 -> 0.505 and is reported as the one counter-instance. All six VERIFIED rows HOLD, PASS at both toolchains, and benchmarks.html's claim that the gradients behind the 28.3 percent were verified now stands re-measured rather than asserted. The second retraction: 'a stock/patched pair restricted to the 7 twist DVs returns BIT-IDENTICAL analytic magnitudes, so the correction is a no-op there' is an artifact of the same wrong script -- an aerostructural wing deflects under load, so the gradient is not evaluated at an undeformed baseline, axisMag exceeds sqrt(eps), and the degenerate branch never fires. proposals.objective: Repair the CBFS field-inversion objective -- restore the benchmark's own inlet profile that the patchV pilot overwrote -- then re-baseline and re-run the Stage 1 inversion with the existing out-of-process driver
proposals.rationale: The Stage 1 CBFS inversion (s1-cbfs-field-inversion-run, 335.98 core-min) failed both pre-registered gates for a measured reason: the case's 0/U inlet is Ux=0.72 uniform (the patchVelocity pilot's write-back; the benchmark ships a developed profile, bulk 0.9149, and the identical Uz noise columns prove the overwrite), so the varianceU loss carries a 27 percent bulk mass-flux mismatch against the Bentaleb LES reference that no interior beta can remove -- 85.1 percent of the loss sits at y>2 in trivially-matched channel flow and only 3.7 percent in the separated-flow window. The inversion machinery itself worked end to end (17 converged adjoints, gradient norm down 106x, bit-identical controls). Plan: (1) restore the benchmark clone's inlet boundaryField into the case and re-verify the FD gate at one cell under the corrected objective; (2) re-baseline varianceU -- PREDICTION, stated before the run: the beta=1 objective falls by well over half once the inlet matches the reference bulk; (3) re-run the existing driver unchanged, with a Wu/Zhang-style sparse-point separation-region loss as the pre-registered variant and lambda_L2 re-tuned and disclosed. The destruction-term patch (w3-beta-on-omega-destruction-model-patch, spec ready) is the term-parity follow-on after this repair; a Dow-style nu_t-discrepancy parameterization is the named alternative if the measured 49.5 percent limiter-binding overlap on the top-decile beta cells caps what the production hook can reach.

proposals.dismiss_reason: Dismissed, not deferred: the estimate is short by two to three orders of magnitude PER RUNG and the item asks for nine. Ruled at 0 core-minutes of solver time in demo-output/website/campaign/W1_TMR_NACA0012_DISPOSITION.md. Eight of the nine rungs do not reach a steady state under this solver configuration -- naca0012_status.json says so in its own first field -- and the root cause is isolated by scheme substitution rather than guessed: second-order momentum advection gives a sustained force oscillation that never decays, antisymmetric on a symmetric case with Cl swings of 0.3 at alpha 0; first-order momentum is perfectly steady and unusable at Cd 0.0229, overdiffused; TVD limitedLinear drops the cycle to about 3e-4 around Cd 0.0090 and never flattens over 15,000 iterations. The ninth rung, the one that IS measured at alpha 10 on 113x33 with Cl 1.1164 and Cd 0.004495, refuses this item's comparison in its own record, because the published CFL3D and FUN3D values are finest-grid 897x257 only and a single coarse rung supports no comparison claim. The time-accurate alternative is priced by the C4 closure at 11,700 to 30,300 core-minutes for ONE rung to 30 convective units, and about 117,000 to 303,000 for the hundreds of convective units the scoping proposal itself required, against measured cold- and seeded-start attempts of 359.5 and 59.9 core-minutes that reached 0.925 and 0.018 units; the seeded start is SLOWER, because the impulsive adjustment from the steady seed is itself the transient. The one cheap repair path was tested this session and REFUTED, which is why the dismissal is safe: w1-bump-on-nasa-own-grids exists because plot3dToFoam damages TMR grids, and the C4 closure blames mesh quality citing max aspect ratio 26,446,226.94 from that same converter, so a direct converter already written and validated would have unblocked this. It does not. Computing cell edge ratios directly from the published node array, with no OpenFOAM and no converter, gives 2.645e+07 -- the same number checkMesh reports -- with the worst cell at the downstream end of the wake cut at a 95.73 streamwise edge against a 3.62e-06 wall-normal one, which is how a C-grid reaching 500 chords while holding its wall spacing is built; 580 cells exceed edge ratio 1e5 and the median cell is 12.1. And the conversion is faithful to the point: checkMesh's 29,152 points are 225 x 65 x 2 nodes less exactly the 49 coincident wake-cut pairs per plane, 49 x 2 = 98. The bump's converter invented geometry; here the converter is right and the geometry is hostile by design. Successor filed, the half of the status record's own next step that is affordable and was never filed: w1-naca0012-dissipation-study, at 25 core-minutes measured, labelled below the hardness floor as an instrument check.

proposals.objective: Prepare a candidate entry for the sixth High-Lift Prediction Workshop test case 1 by running the published CRM-HLS blind case on the coarsest committee grid of 2.66 million cells across the six specified angles of attack, and assess whether the result is strong enough to be worth Katie approving an approach to the workshop organisers
proposals.rationale: This is the strongest externally verified credential currently open to this lab, and the scouting sweep of 2026-07-30 found it by looking. The workshop is underway as of January 2026 with the meeting expected June 2027, its submission repository is already public, and its participant list is full of companies including Boeing, Embraer, ONERA, DLR, JAXA and Bombardier, so a commercial entrant is normal rather than exceptional. Membership of the sponsoring society is not required. Decisively for us, the coarsest published grid is 2.66 million cells, which is under five times our largest ever converged primal, and the case is deliberately blind with no experimental data published, so there is nothing to tune toward and placing well cannot be an artifact of hindsight. A workshop entry that is externally rescored is worth more to this company than another internal case

proposals.cost_basis: Measured on this machine on 2026-08-01, replacing the earlier estimate. The coarsest committee grid was downloaded, imported, decomposed and solved here. It parses to exactly 2661338 cells, 1156796 nodes and 6509759 faces, all prisms, pyramids and tetrahedra, which confirms the cited cell count against the grid file itself. Peak memory across every stage was 4548 MiB against 31380 MiB of host memory, a headroom factor of 6.7, so the memory question the earlier basis left open is answered and memory was never the risk. The per cell figure comes from a measured slope over a four rung ladder at 334647, 673920, 1320300 and 2664180 cells rather than from one point, and it over predicts the real grid by 11 percent because a structured mesh carries more faces per cell, so it is a bound in the safe direction. Throughput measured at 120 iterations in 182.63 seconds on 14 ranks, which is 0.355 core minutes per iteration, 2.02 times the rate the earlier basis assumed. The cause is rank count and grid type, not cell count: rung A6 ran 4 ranks on a structured extruded mesh and parallel efficiency here is about 45 percent, so 14 ranks buys 6.3 times the wall speed for 2.23 times the core minutes. Carrying the earlier assumption of 3000 iterations across the six angles gives 6390 core minutes at 14 ranks, or 4014 serial over 67 hours of wall time. Two things remain unpriced and are stated rather than hidden. The iteration count is still an assumption, which is the same defect that overran the flat plate finest rung, and at the upper angles steady RANS often refuses to settle. And the configuration measured as stable uses first order convection, which is not a defensible submission; a second order entry is dearer and less robust. What actually blocks this item is not memory but numerics on a grid built for node centred codes, with 1256565 severely non orthogonal faces, plus the fact that no reader for the published grid format existed here until one was written.
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: The first externally rescored aerodynamic result this lab would ever hold, on a blind case, judged beside national laboratories and airframers. Even a mediocre placement establishes that our pipeline runs a modern high lift configuration end to end at several million cells, which no current record demonstrates. A failure is nearly as informative, since it would locate our ceiling against a published grid rather than against our own guess

proposals.cost_basis_previous: Estimate, anchored on our own measured throughput and deliberately conservative. Rung A6 converged 579072 cells in 38.4 core-min for 1000 iterations, which is 6.6e-5 core-min per cell per 1000 iterations. The coarsest workshop grid is 2661338 cells, so one angle of attack at 3000 iterations scales to about 530 core-min, and the six specified angles to about 3200 core-min. Rounded to 3600 to allow for a high-lift case needing more iterations to settle than a cruise wing does. This is the largest single compute request on the docket and it is a real commitment, not a screen. Memory is the genuine risk and is not established: A6 held 30 GB free at 579072 cells but this grid is 4.6 times larger, so the first action must be a memory probe on a single angle before the remaining five are queued. Dollars: zero for the grids, which are anonymous public downloads. Any attendance fee is a separate decision and is not established for this edition

proposals.objective: Adopt the rule that a ladder increment may not be published as a FEATURE without draw-scatter evidence at the rung it turns on, or with the absence of that evidence stated on its face; and price the retrofit of every stored ladder that lacks it
proposals.rationale: Every ladder in this lab that has ever had replicate meshes drawn at a rung has returned a material finding, and the count is four for four. B-52: the published turn of -4.055e-3 turned out to be max(rung 6) minus min(rung 7) of eight same-recipe draws, re-estimating to +8.2e-5 +/- 1.2e-3 with the sign flipped, and the turn is WITHDRAWN as a claim (chief ruling 7abb0ba3). NACA 0012: three of four meshes built to the same recipe at the graded resolution land inside the reference band and the PUBLISHED mesh is the family maximum at plus 1.35 sigma, so the row published a fail from the one draw in four that fails. NACA 4412: a three-rung replicate sweep measured construction scatter at 5.82, 12.74 and 4.20 percent of the mean, not monotone, with the graded rung the worst of the three. Ahmed 25: one same-recipe redraw at the turn's previously untested lower end moves Cd by 6.6x the increment and flips its sign, and the claim is under active test at n=2 of a planned 4. THE CHECK HAS NEVER ONCE COME BACK CLEAN. Nothing in the corpus is presently wrong -- every stored study reads conclusive false and none publishes a reportable band -- but nothing is presently checked either, and the two families that were checked have had their headline features withdrawn or put under test. The defect is structural rather than local: uq.eca_hoekstra_band cannot infer draw scatter from a cell-count and value series, so a ladder can be fitted, banded and quoted without anyone ever asking whether its increments exceed the scatter of the meshes they are differences of. The rule does not forbid publishing a ladder; it forbids publishing an increment as a FEATURE -- a turn, an oscillation, a divergence, a trend in increments -- while the scatter at the rung that feature turns on is unmeasured, unless the absence is stated where the feature is stated.
proposals.gate: Adopted only with the archive replay on the record, per the charter: replayed against every stored ladder and every campaign record that states a ladder feature, with counts recorded BEFORE adoption -- how many records state a feature, how many of those have draw-scatter evidence at the deciding rung, and how many would be restated rather than withdrawn. Prediction, written before the replay: a minority of records fire, they are the ones stating a turn or an oscillation rather than a monotone trend, and the retrofit is cheaper than the two checks already run. A rule that fires on every record or on none fails its own entry condition and is not adopted. Separately, the retrofit is priced per ladder and offered as a menu, not a mandate: the price is the point of the filing, since it tells the lab what its unchecked ladders would cost to check
proposals.cost_basis: MEASURED, from this family's own two replicate campaigns, and stated as a band because two bodies disagree by a factor of 1.7 on cost per cell. Per-draw cost per 1000 cells: Ahmed c3 3.9 core-min at 254,911 cells on 4 ranks = 0.0153; B-52 rung 6 8.6 core-min at 330,950 cells on 2 ranks = 0.0260. Retrofit = 2 new draws at the turn rung (n=1 -> n=3, the minimum that yields a sample sd) for each unchecked ladder. SCOPE, corrected by recounting rather than re-reading: 12 stored studies, but 4 carry no ladder at all (airliner-wing, aortic-valve, tmr_flatplate_fine, tmr_flatplate_modelform have zero rungs), so 8 real ladders, of which 3 already carry draw evidence -- the retrofit scope is FIVE ladders, not the nine an earlier sweep of mine reported. Per ladder: ahmed_25 1.4-2.4, ahmed_35 1.4-2.4, motorBike 2.0-3.4, cube 3.2-5.4, naca0015_sail 4.8-8.1. TOTAL 12.8-21.7 core-min. est_core_min carries the upper bound because a floor recorded as an estimate manufactures false confidence
proposals.expected_knowledge_gain: The whole corpus's ladder features either gain a measured scatter or gain a stated absence, at a total price BELOW what checking the B-52 alone cost (40.9 core-min, which ended in a withdrawal). Either a minority of features are draw-sensitive and the wall gains a rule that stops one mesh from deciding a published shape, or most are and the finding is that the lab's ladder layer is under-replicated as a class -- which resets the replicate budget before the next ladder is fitted
